sample_unit: questions (FAQs, each entered once into two ChatGPT versions)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 versus ChatGPT-4.5 responses to stuttering FAQs
links.effect: GPT-4.5 responses were about 63% shorter but modestly less readable than GPT-4 responses. Abstract gives no grade-level figures or comparison to patient literacy.
links.quote: Despite increased concision, GPT-4.5 responses were modestly less readable.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to stuttering-related FAQs across two versions without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
